<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election Commission controversy:</strong> The Congress party has demanded the immediate suspension of the Chief Election Commissioner, while YS Jagan Reddy has expressed regret over his past support for the current law governing the appointment of Election Commissioners, calling for the Chief Justice of India to be reinstated to the selection panel.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQNHFMeGpRTXRVMnFtOUNHd3VuZTBVX1RRNmhfUDRXSlVIUTRuQk5xaUlRaWJKclNiOElLUlJTR09VM01tWGNPM2I1Vi1qNWlBOGNjRWYxX0dRQ0pVU2tTNWItVGl2UlpRVjdMRHFidE5Pcl9mMmFuRFJwRUJoREUzQW1pYk9CelRibFJyZmlhcDNBOFBKc0ZUMmptcw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxORVVZa0JyeXFVckxBbDc0aHQwREFYeEFhdEFfTVlfMkF4WE1fWW5kRWprOW42dUVvMy1mb0p3ODRDZFdvWllLdUxNRHRweGJMNl9ocjFocUgtZmEwUTh5bUhSaUFqV2ZoaW9DTUVSaEhtRDA5MWNxWEt2d2pxTlNhaE5rSU5tSDMxYXRIVDNKdmt6LTV5N1NoSmdDQVA0Vkt1SHYxUUNyWFplT2M5ZlE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxQVTZ1YWNMLWlWNmRRN0JQZndxWkhPaVg0TmQ4RF9xQ1FRUGNTVWVXcFp1bUlQWHBZTmp5bE9fQjl0UF9fVTNxa3ZXcFMyZ19tS0RJbm1CM2pHa01WNmg2Y0dTNUpqVVJGOWZnNi1JM3ZhbjQ1LXFMM0dwSW5HOXhvamx3ZHZtbm43dl9xREVGRi1GaXV3TTdIX2NPSnRoRnp4QlpmRzQ3Z3BfZG9odmd6MDgydkJ2MzNJWmYwOA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>

  <li><strong>Menstrual hygiene mandate:</strong> The Supreme Court has issued a stern warning to states for failing to comply with its previous directives regarding the provision of menstrual hygiene facilities in schools.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>International diplomacy:</strong> Defence Minister Rajnath Singh is set to represent India at the upcoming Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Council of Heads of Government meeting in Tajikistan.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNdDdDNFpldS1EM0lZSWJDU3JtV3BGVFlNNVpuaDJBOVRENzJMcEhTbUw4MmV0LWpMUDhrUElHWXRnSTVCbWFEV2pBQnJaU1hNVnI1bEhQbENyOEc0d2E4dVNMRzJORF80cF9NMXFQa2tQSFNDaFUyMHZhNDBjenZrUmFMb2tKY09MSGlnMDNteTZ6dk5VLURHbS1mcnMzSUZBcGRQenFB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Electoral roll disputes:</strong> The Delhi High Court has upheld the use of Form 6 for voter registration, even as political friction continues between the BJP and Congress over the implementation and transparency of machine-readable voter lists.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
